format: OSwind targeted primary-source landscape refresh v1
scope: Six of twenty existing offering profiles rechecked. Others retain October29 dates. Publisher text/cache evidence only; no vendor app, checkout, account, local archive or clipboard was opened.

vendors.name: Screenpipe
vendors.observation: Annual plan defaults unchanged. Entitlement prose/table differ. Source licensing remains restricted; desktop release numbers differ from the benchmarked CLI.
vendors.powerClaims: Changelog describes battery-triggered audio/capture pauses and reduced idle work. Architecture describes event triggers with fallback capture. These are unmeasured publisher claims.
vendors.storageBoundary: Documentation says switching data directories does not migrate old history and can fall back when an external drive disappears; OSwind needs independent failover-policy acceptance.

vendors.name: Original Rewind / Limitless
vendors.observation: Reachable help pages cover exports and unsupported legacy Rewind API access. Pricing help conflicts with the wind-down announcement available in an older publisher search snapshot; current availability remains unresolved.

vendors.name: Rewind Desktop (rewind.app)
vendors.observation: Homepage accessible; direct comparison fetches fail. Publisher search snapshots repeat the monthly quote. No checkout or runtime accepted.

vendors.name: Pieces
vendors.observation: Monthly prices, card-required trial and absence of a free plan remain displayed. Quarterly enterprise option is now recorded.

vendors.name: Littlebird
vendors.observation: Plan limits and AWS/cloud processing remain explicit; Pro12x pricing is not selected or inferred.

vendors.name: Granola
vendors.observation: Plan prices remain displayed. Free-plan MCP scope and voice typing are now explicit; voice typing becomes an unimplemented OSwind requirement.

existingRequirementClarifications.boundary: Modes, adaptive policies and idle model release do not prove sustained physical power budgets.
Per-routine AI configuration is distinct from a reusable preset management workflow.
Source favorites and meeting grouping do not automatically establish timed/starred session workflows.
Closing a window, quitting an app, search availability and continuing capture require separate explicit semantics.

rendering.state: regenerated20offerings83requirements; structural checks pass, desktop/narrow browser QA pending after benchmark
rendering.copyControl: Static byte inspection confirms the expected JavaScript newline escape (quote, backslash, n, quote); the earlier escaping suspicion is cleared. Runtime copy behavior remains part of pending browser QA. No renderer defect established or source patch needed.

sourcePolicy: Own-product claims use the publisher itself. Competitor comparisons are not treated as independent evidence about the other product. No source code copied or license acceptance inferred.
